opportunities.title: Field Research Team - 4 Roles (Field Researcher, Research Analyst, IoT/Hardware Engineer, Community Health Liaison)
opportunities.organization: DialSense (a project under BahoCare, healthcare technology venture in Kigali)
opportunities.eligibility_nationality: ALU Students Specifically Targeted; Open to others based on skills
opportunities.field: Health Tech, Field Research, IoT/Hardware, Community Health, Data Analysis
opportunities.tags: Field Research, Health Tech, Rwanda, Kigali, ALU, IoT, Predictive Maintenance, Dialysis, Community Health, Startup
opportunities.description: DialSense is building predictive maintenance for dialysis machines in Kigali hospitals - addressing a real clinical problem where machine downtime affects patient care. Currently recruiting 4 roles for the field research team: (1) Field Researcher - conducting on-site hospital observations and data collection; (2) Research Analyst - synthesizing field data into actionable insights; (3) IoT/Hardware Engineer (1 slot only) - sensor design and hardware prototyping; (4) Community Health Liaison - bridging hospital staff, patients, and research team. Application takes about 5-10 minutes. Rolling review. NOTE: This appears to be an early-stage venture - students should verify compensation, legal entity structure (BahoCare vs DialSense), and role expectations directly with the recruiting team before committing significant time. Best fit for ALU students and Kigali-based undergrads interested in health tech, field research, or clinical operations.

opportunities.title: Brand Designer
opportunities.eligibility_nationality: Open to All (Worldwide - Supabase hires globally)
opportunities.field: Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Brand Design, Digital Media, Print Design
opportunities.tags: Remote, Worldwide, Design, Brand, Figma, Adobe, Startup, Open Source, ESOP, Global Benefits
opportunities.description: Fully remote Brand Designer role with Supabase, the open-source Postgres development platform (~400 team members across 60+ countries, $1B+ raised). Work spans visual storytelling across presentation decks, printed materials, YouTube content, conference assets, and swag - collaborating with Marketing, DevRel, Enterprise, and Events teams while maintaining brand consistency. REQUIREMENTS: Strong Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) proficiency; comfort designing across digital, print, and video formats; clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences; comfort with async work and ambiguity. BENEFITS: Full remote with co-working allowance, equity (ESOP), tech allowance, 100% employee health insurance coverage globally, annual education allowance, annual company off-site. ⚠️ SENIORITY NOTE: No explicit years requirement, but JD signals mid-level - print production knowledge (paper weights), leading projects end-to-end, and setting design standards. Realistic for recent design grads with a genuinely strong portfolio; highly competitive globally. Portfolio required.

opportunities.title: AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship 2027 – Fully Funded Undergraduate Degree at American University

opportunities.description: ⚠️ Open to non-U.S. international students applying for their first undergraduate degree. Fully funded scholarship covering tuition, room, and board, renewable for up to four years.
opportunities.raw_jd: AU Emerging Global Leader Scholarship 2027 supports international students pursuing their first undergraduate degree at American University in Washington, DC. Applicants must be non-U.S. international citizens, require a student visa, have graduated from high school in 2024 or later, meet English proficiency requirements, demonstrate strong academic achievement and leadership, and have a record of volunteering and community service. The scholarship covers full tuition, room, and board and is renewable for up to four years. Non-billable expenses such as health insurance, books, airfare, taxes, and miscellaneous expenses are not covered.

opportunities.title: International Merit-Based Scholarship - £5,000 Tuition Reduction (January 2027 Intake)
opportunities.eligibility_year: Applicants who already hold a Kingston offer (Final Year / Recent Grad)
opportunities.eligibility_nationality: International (overseas-fee) students with an existing Kingston offer
opportunities.tags: Scholarship, Partial Funding, Tuition Discount, UK, Kingston University, International Students, Merit-Based, January 2027, Personal Statement
opportunities.description: Deadline Monday 23 November 2026; results announced by 7 December 2026. A £5,000 reduction in tuition fees for one year of study, awarded on merit to international students who already have an offer from Kingston University London for the January or September intake. Applications are open for January 2027. WHAT YOU SUBMIT: your offer email and a 300-word personal statement covering why you want to study at Kingston and why you would be a good "champion" for the university. Judging is on your reasons for choosing Kingston and your enthusiasm and ability to support Kingston's recruitment and marketing work. If you pay by instalments, the £5,000 comes off your final instalment; if you pay in full upfront, deduct it from the total. ⚠️ THIS IS A PARTIAL TUITION DISCOUNT, NOT A FULL SCHOLARSHIP. It is £5,000 off, for one year only, and does not cover living costs, visa, flights or the rest of your tuition. ⚠️ YOU MUST ALREADY HOLD AN OFFER. You cannot apply for this first: apply to Kingston, receive your offer, then apply for the scholarship. ⚠️ Level of study is not stated in the summary we could verify. Earlier Kingston rounds were for postgraduate taught courses, so confirm on the official page that your course is covered. Confirm the deadline on Kingston's page before submitting.
